Virginia Valor FCThe club
Who we are

Two clubs, one pathway

Virginia Valor FC is the travel club of Chantilly Youth Association and Southwestern Youth Association. The two clubs combined their travel programs in 2021.

Virginia Valor FCHome ground
Our local reach

Rooted in Fairfax County

Valor's growth comes from recruitment and steady outreach to new players and families.

Valor reaches about 700 players and families across Northern Virginia, West Virginia and Maryland. Home is Chantilly, Herndon and Centreville, and players also travel in from Loudoun, Arlington and Prince William Counties.

Virginia Valor FCThe pathway
Valor programs

Six levels, one club

From recreational soccer at U4 to national league play at U19, a player can grow up inside one pathway.

Alongside: Competitive Futsal in winter, USL-Y and PRO U23 in summer, and goalkeeper training.
